steps.description:
The `libraries` folder groups together the project’s core helper libraries.
- `src/libraries/FixedPointMath.sol`
- `src/libraries/SafeCast.sol`
- `src/libraries/SafeERC20.sol`
- `src/libraries/TokenUtils.sol`
- `src/libraries/Sets.sol`
- `src/libraries/NFTMetadataGenerator.sol`
- `src/libraries/StakingGraph.sol`
- `src/libraries/PositionDecay.sol`

Fixed-precision decimals are represented with 18 decimals of precision.
Line 11 stores the DECIMALS constant.
Line 12 pre-computes ONE = 10**DECIMALS so that multiplication/division can stay in integer space.
Lines 17-19 wrap the raw uint256 in a lightweight Number struct that is passed around by the rest of the math helpers.

SafeCast defends against overflow/underflow when converting between integer sizes and signs.
- toInt256 (12-17) reverts if the uint256 is too large for a signed 256-bit integer.
- toUint256 (22-27) forbids casting negative numbers to unsigned.
- uint256ToUint128 (32-37) makes sure the larger value fits into 128 bits.
- uint128ToUint256 (42-45) is a safe widening conversion.

SafeERC20 wraps raw low-level calls so that silent ERC-20 failures revert with a rich error.
Line 19 defines the shared ERC20CallFailed error carrying (target,success,data).
Lines 39-52 – safeTransfer
Lines 63-69 – safeApprove
Lines 80-86 – safeTransferFrom
All three functions bubble up any false return value or malformed/no return data.

TokenUtils exposes the same ERC20CallFailed error (17) and then a complete suite of helper functions that cover balance queries and supply-changing operations in addition to the transfer helpers.
- expectDecimals         26-34
- safeBalanceOf          44-52
- safeTransfer           61-67
- safeApprove            76-82
- safeTransferFrom       92-97
- safeMint              107-113
- safeBurn              121-126
- safeBurnFrom          136-141
Each helper performs the call and checks both code size and return data before allowing execution to proceed.

`AddressSet` is an on-chain set implemented with `O(1)` lookup.
- `values` – dynamic array holding the unique addresses (line 10)
- `indexes` – mapping address→index+1 so that index 0 flags "not present" (line 11).

`NFTMetadataGenerator` builds fully on-chain metadata strings.
- `generateSVG` (19-44) assembles a small SVG with colors, title and token id.
- `generateJSONString` (53-66) base64-encodes the SVG and packs it into a JSON object.
- `generateTokenURI` (74-77) prefixes the JSON with a `data:application/json;base64` URI header so that it can be returned from tokenURI().

StakingGraph packs two Fenwick trees into one storage array for block-granular stake accounting.
- `Graph` struct (35-40) stores current tree size and the packed `uint256` array `g[]`.
- `addStake` (50-98) updates the double-tree by inserting +`delta` at `start` and -`delta` at `expiration`, expanding the tree capacity when necessary.
- `queryStake` (108-124) returns the net amount that has vested between two blocks by querying prefix sums at `start-1` and `end` and combining them.

`PositionDecay` transforms multiplicative decay into additive log-space to preserve precision.
- `WeightIncrement` (39-57) computes `−log₂((total-increment)/total)` expressed as a `UQ136.120` fixed-point value.
- `ScaleByWeightDelta` (67-83) applies a previously computed `weightDelta` to `value`, effectively calculating `value – value·2^(−weightDelta)` to determine the decayed portion.
